title: Delete empty directory
summary: Removes a directory only if it is empty. This is a safer method than recursive deletion because it fails if the directory contains any files.

steps.explain: Removes the specified directory. The command will fail if the directory is not empty.

placeholders.name: DIRECTORY_PATH
placeholders.description: Path to the empty directory you want to delete.

warnings: The command will fail if the directory contains any files or subdirectories.
Deleted directories cannot be easily recovered.

rollback.explain: You can recreate the directory using 'mkdir <DIRECTORY_PATH>' if you know the name.
